item.title: Human Chain Protest Planned Outside Kennedy Center Friday Night
item.description:
An activist group opposing President Donald Trump’s takeover of the Kennedy Center said it will form a “human chain” outside the Washington, D.C. arts venue Friday evening, demanding Trump be removed as chairman for failing to “protect & manage this vibrant arts memorial to a slain President.”

item.title: Security Researchers Hacked Into OpenAI Using Anthropic’s Claude
item.description:
A group of cybersecurity researchers managed to breach OpenAI’s internal system using rival Anthropic’s Claude AI software as part of a bug bounty program, highlighting the growing threats posed by advanced AI models amid broader safety warnings about the technology from top industry executives and researchers.
READ MORE https://www.forbes.com/sites/siladityaray/2026/09/18/security-researchers-hacked-into-openai-using-anthropics-claude/
